FAQ

Completely. Unlimited flips, all 17 calculators, price alerts, profit tracking — no premium tiers, no limits. The data is public, so we keep the tools public too.

The OSRS Wiki Real-Time Prices API — the same source every GE tool uses. It pulls directly from actual Grand Exchange transactions and updates every 60 seconds.

Margin = Sell Price - Buy Price - GE Tax (2%, capped at 5M GP). Every margin you see already has the tax baked in, so what you see is what you actually profit.

It pulls the live nature rune price from the GE, then calculates Alch Profit = High Alch Value - Buy Price - Nature Rune Cost. Items are ranked by profit per cast so you can start alching immediately.

Paste a Discord webhook URL, set your target price on any item, done. When the price crosses your threshold, you get a rich embed notification in your Discord channel. Set as many as you want.

No. Everything works in your browser with local storage. If you want to sync your watchlist and trades across devices, you can optionally sign in with Discord — takes 2 seconds.
